methods.what: Algebraic expansion of the product of a sum of two squares by a square, rewritten in terms of aA−bB and aB−bA (related to the norm of a product of complex numbers a+bi and A+Bi)
Geometric representation of Gaussian integers as lattice points, with tilted squares (multiples of a complex number) covering the lattice, around a centre a−1
